---
title: "Live-birth interaction search"
output: html_document
editor_options:
  chunk_output_type: console
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = rprojroot::find_rstudio_root_file())
library(dplyr)
library(pROC)
library(knitr)
```

```{r run}
# Metrics reproduce the PipelineA_01 out-of-sample check exactly:
# fit each candidate on df_lb_train, evaluate on df_lb_val, clip at 1e-4,
# AUC via pROC::roc, calibration from glm(y ~ logit(pred_raw)) on df_lb_val.
# The reported slope/intercept are therefore the single 80/20 validation
# values the pipeline uses (the same numbers that reach pricing and Excel),
# not cross-validated averages.

outcome_col <- "birth_bool"
predictors  <- c("age_model", "amh", "afc")
eps         <- 1e-4

df_train <- readr::read_rds("data/models/df_lb_train.rds")
df_val   <- readr::read_rds("data/models/df_lb_val.rds")
df_train[[outcome_col]] <- as.numeric(df_train[[outcome_col]])
df_val[[outcome_col]]   <- as.numeric(df_val[[outcome_col]])

clip_prob <- function(x, e = eps) pmax(pmin(x, 1 - e), e)

# Candidate set: main effects fixed, every hierarchy-respecting interaction
# structure over the three predictors, plus the full 3-way.
two_way_terms   <- combn(predictors, 2, FUN = function(v) paste(v, collapse = ":"))
two_way_subsets <- do.call(c, lapply(0:length(two_way_terms),
  function(k) combn(two_way_terms, k, simplify = FALSE)))

build_formula <- function(interaction_terms) {
  rhs <- paste(c(predictors, interaction_terms), collapse = " + ")
  list(formula = as.formula(paste(outcome_col, "~", rhs)),
       label   = if (length(interaction_terms) == 0) "main effects only"
                 else paste(interaction_terms, collapse = " + "))
}

candidates <- lapply(two_way_subsets, build_formula)
candidates[[length(candidates) + 1]] <- list(
  formula = as.formula(paste(outcome_col, "~ age_model * amh * afc")),
  label   = "full 3-way: age_model * amh * afc")

eval_candidate <- function(cand) {
  fit <- suppressWarnings(glm(cand$formula, data = df_train, family = binomial))

  # Out-of-sample predictions on the validation split.
  p_val <- clip_prob(predict(fit, newdata = df_val, type = "response"))
  y_val <- df_val[[outcome_col]]

  auc_val   <- as.numeric(pROC::roc(y_val, p_val, quiet = TRUE)$auc)
  brier_val <- mean((p_val - y_val)^2, na.rm = TRUE)

  # Validation-derived calibration, same form as PipelineA_01.
  cal <- suppressWarnings(
    glm(y_val ~ log(p_val / (1 - p_val)), family = binomial))
  cal_int   <- unname(coef(cal)[1])
  cal_slope <- unname(coef(cal)[2])

  # In-sample AUC on the training split, for reference.
  p_tr    <- clip_prob(predict(fit, newdata = df_train, type = "response"))
  auc_tr  <- as.numeric(pROC::roc(df_train[[outcome_col]], p_tr, quiet = TRUE)$auc)

  data.frame(
    model         = cand$label,
    n_params      = fit$rank,
    val_auc       = round(auc_val, 4),
    train_auc     = round(auc_tr, 4),
    val_brier     = round(brier_val, 4),
    cal_intercept = round(cal_int, 4),
    cal_slope     = round(cal_slope, 4),
    AIC           = round(AIC(fit), 1),
    BIC           = round(BIC(fit), 1),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

results_tbl <- lapply(candidates, eval_candidate) |>
  dplyr::bind_rows() |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    cal_slope_flag = dplyr::case_when(
      cal_slope >= 0.80 & cal_slope <= 1.20 ~ "OK",
      cal_slope >= 0.60 & cal_slope <= 1.50 ~ "review",
      TRUE                                  ~ "action needed"),
    cal_int_flag = dplyr::case_when(
      abs(cal_intercept) <= 0.20 ~ "OK",
      abs(cal_intercept) <= 0.50 ~ "review",
      TRUE                       ~ "action needed")
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(val_auc))

dir.create("outputs", showWarnings = FALSE)
readr::write_csv(results_tbl, "outputs/live_birth_interaction_search.csv")

kable(results_tbl)
```
